flagged_sentences: Violette Dorange on Initiatives-Cœur collided with Romain Pilliard's trimaran Use It Again near Île de Bréhat shortly after the start, damaging her starboard foil; both boats diverted to Roscoff for repairs while the skippers remained unhurt.

claims.claim: Thomas Ruyant withdrew from the Route du Rhum before the start because he could not close his budget.
